title: Gueguis
summary: A Babylon placename for Little Neck, recorded in an August 1696 deed and generally associated with the necks south of Lindenhurst/Breslau.
address_label: General Little Neck area south of Lindenhurst, Town of Babylon, NY
introduction_content: Gueguis is Tooker's recorded name for Little Neck in the Town of Babylon. The name appears in an August 1696 deed that identifies the same neck by its English and Indigenous names.
translation_content:
Recorded forms include Gueguis and Little Neck. Tooker does not provide a translation for Gueguis in the available references.

Why Place Names Matter

“Language, history, geography, all of those things come together in place names, and they are part of the language, part of our psyche.”

— Donald Orth, 2008 interview on place names (2008), quoted in Erik Johnson, ‘Donald Orth: King of Alaska Place Names,’ paragraph 4
land_loss_content: Gueguis preserves a small Babylon neck name from a single surviving deed. Recording it carefully keeps a local Indigenous place reference visible while separating it from other Long Island places also called Little Neck.
whereintheworld_content: Tooker places Gueguis near Little Neck, with later associations to the Breslau and Lindenhurst area. The historic neck boundaries and creek names remain uncertain.
